issue-4202: Export reports as TSV?
Opened by data-eng-priya on 2026-09-09

Our warehouse loader only accepts tab-delimited files. Could report export offer
that format next to CSV and XLSX?

Right now we export CSV and convert it by hand, which goes wrong whenever a
transaction description contains
